research_plan.effect_boundary_status: Minimum T3/T4 composition is proved under the consuming receiver contract: both source receipts match actual verification data and cannot be reused for another effect. The concrete eight-role, two-runtime handoff fixture connects both R/S receives and publication to one checked EPF execution, including actual argument and verification data. Extending this correspondence to all effect entries and argument types, remaining task ports and final consumer qualification remains pending. Twelve migrated tasks have actual-Wasm checks under earlier ordinary Git pins; the 75-condition result and live pilots apply only to their recorded source versions in plan.md. Review and CI/CD wire labels, lanes, peers and delegated envelopes are checked against the compiled projection. Review/6E also connects complete producer capture to EPF source-execution interpretation and frame correspondence; this does not certify application effects or other families. The selected core and libraries have completed their recorded local contracts. Current dependency graphs and qualification receipts are recorded in plan.md; updated consumer actual-Wasm and live-model qualification is not complete.

analysis.interpretation: Zero observed violations is not a universal safety proof; nonsignificance is not equivalence; report insufficient precision and negative results

Module owners offer the actual result branches; failure permits another loan while success leaves the other developer active. preserved: Original two developers, reviewer and single physical repository
Implementation before its actual code review
Approval of that feature before merge
Exclusive repository ownership during implementation and merge

review_procedure.procedure: The global is constructed from actual business requests, delegated repository operations, results and returns. The reviewer's validated request selects the first target and can select the other target after a failed review. Independent implementation and review, and merge and review, are projected parallel fragments driven with try_join. Approval-dependent merges and successful termination occur inside the successful result branches; failed results leave routes to revision and review. File operations do not complete a business phase
review_procedure.ownership: The repository service owns the sole initial repository Endpoint and receives the actual loan request. The guest receives that Endpoint by move, sends its actual implementation or merge arguments through it, receives the original simulator result and returns the same Endpoint. The service checks those arguments before executing the effect. Developer intermediary roles and review-only auxiliary views have been removed. Actual review requests and results carry branch knowledge to the affected participants; there is no application owner table or progress flag
review_procedure.interface: Every WASI syscall, including private file operations, runs through the private I/O choreography and ChoreoFS. Feature and branch arguments must match the participant. Invalid arguments and unavailable requests return shell errors before any repository effect, without advancing the business operation. Guest computation and private file operations remain independent
review_procedure.qualification: Ordinary pinned Git dependencies pass twenty-six actual-WASI trials: original failure conditions 0/1/2, either first target, three review schedules and eight original-delay cases. Eight additional unscored mechanism cases extend the rejection prefix to three or four through the unchanged simulator API. All thirty-four cases pass with zero violations, and their audits reject 928 record mutations, including repeated same-argument request/close/result removal, consistently altered wire labels or lanes, and substitution of a different statically valid review message. These are record checks, not runtime attacks. Original-delay cases require actual implementation/review and merge/review overlap. The scored 0/1/2 matrix is unchanged. A three-Luna-xhigh pilot at source 252b821 with its recorded ordinary Git pins completed in 30.29 seconds at depth 2, with four reviews, six resource requests and returns, zero violations and 284,702 inclusive tokens. It observed three implementation/review overlaps and one merge/review overlap. These are unscored pilot observations. The executable exports its compiled projection before the run; its artifact and executable hashes are bound to the run receipt, and the actual attached programs emit the same metadata. Every frame is checked against this static wire contract. Dynamic branch and iteration eligibility are not replayed by this auditor. Full-condition qualification and final matched task acceptance remain pending
